headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 8, 2026**
article:
The New York Yankees edged out the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested matchup, with Gerrit Cole leading the way for the Yankees. Cole pitched 7.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, including Jack Leiter of the Texas Rangers, who has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a right ankle posterior impingement. Other notable injuries include Ben Williamson of the Tampa Bay Rays, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a right hamstring strain, and Luis Urías of the Toronto Blue Jays, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a right quad strain.

The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring 1B Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals in a trade that brings new depth to the team's first base position. Other notable trades include the Athletics acquiring RHP Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies and the Miami Marlins trading RHP Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for RHP Brandan Bidois, LF Brian Sanchez, and IF Hyun Seung Lee.

top_news.title: **Braves Fall Short in Bronx Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged out the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested matchup. Gerrit Cole led the way for the Yankees, pitching 7.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Athletics Take Down Red Sox 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Gage Jump leading the way on the mound. Jump pitched 6.0 innings, striking out 11 batters while allowing 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Shut Down Angels 7-0**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins dominated the Los Angeles Angels in a 7-0 victory, with Sandy Alcantara leading the way on the mound. Alcantara pitched 7.0 innings, striking out 8 batters and allowing no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Phillies 7-5**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 7-5 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Nathan Lukes leading the offense. Lukes hit 3 home runs, including a key 6th homer that scored Brandon Valenzuela.

top_news.title: **Rangers' Jack Leiter Shifted to 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Texas Rangers right-handed pitcher Jack Leiter has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right ankle posterior impingement.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring 1B Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals in a trade that brings new depth to the team's first base position.
